mediaAssets.title: Grand Finale of "Campus Power Presenter 2019" season 1.... অনুষ্ঠানে প্রধান অতিথি হিসেবে উপস্থিত ছিলেন জগন্নাথ বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের উপাচার্য অধ্যাপক ড. মীজানুর রহমান। বিশেষ অতিথি হিসেবে উপস্থিত ছিলেন বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের কোষাধ্যক্ষ অধ্যাপক ড. সেলিম ভুইয়া। এছাড়াও অনুষ্ঠানে বিচারক এর দায়িত্ব পালন করেন সিএসই ডিপার্টমেন্টের সহযোগী অধ্যাপক জনাব মেসবাউল আলম পলাশ, আইন অনুষদের ডিন খ্রিস্টিন রিচার্ডসন এবং ইন্সটিটিউট অব মডার্ণ ল্যাংগুয়েজ এর ডিরেক্টর ড.প্রতিভা রানী কর্মকার। অনুষ্ঠানে সভাপতিত্ব করেন সংগঠন এর উপদেষ্টা ও সিএসই ডিপার্টমেন্টের চেয়ারম্যান অধ্যাপক ড.উজ্জ্বল কুমার আচার্য্য। #CPP2019 #JnUITS

mediaAssets.title: Grand Finale of "Campus Power Presenter 2019" season 1.... অনুষ্ঠানে প্রধান অতিথি হিসেবে উপস্থিত ছিলেন জগন্নাথ বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের উপাচার্য অধ্যাপক ড. মীজানুর রহমান। বিশেষ অতিথি হিসেবে উপস্থিত ছিলেন বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের কোষাধ্যক্ষ অধ্যাপক ড. সেলিম ভুইয়া। এছাড়াও অনুষ্ঠানে বিচারক এর দায়িত্ব পালন করেন সিএসই ডিপার্টমেন্টের সহযোগী অধ্যাপক জনাব মেসবাউল আলম পলাশ, আইন অনুষদের ডিন খ্রিস্টিন রিচার্ডসন এবং ইন্সটিটিউট অব মডার্ণ ল্যাংগুয়েজ এর ডিরেক্টর ড.প্রতিভা রানী কর্মকার। অনুষ্ঠানে সভাপতিত্ব করেন সংগঠন এর উপদেষ্টা ও সিএসই ডিপার্টমেন্টের চেয়ারম্যান অধ্যাপক ড.উজ্জ্বল কুমার আচার্য্য। #CPP2019 #JnUITS

mediaAssets.title: Grand Finale of "Campus Power Presenter 2019" season 1.... অনুষ্ঠানে প্রধান অতিথি হিসেবে উপস্থিত ছিলেন জগন্নাথ বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের উপাচার্য অধ্যাপক ড. মীজানুর রহমান। বিশেষ অতিথি হিসেবে উপস্থিত ছিলেন বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের কোষাধ্যক্ষ অধ্যাপক ড. সেলিম ভুইয়া। এছাড়াও অনুষ্ঠানে বিচারক এর দায়িত্ব পালন করেন সিএসই ডিপার্টমেন্টের সহযোগী অধ্যাপক জনাব মেসবাউল আলম পলাশ, আইন অনুষদের ডিন খ্রিস্টিন রিচার্ডসন এবং ইন্সটিটিউট অব মডার্ণ ল্যাংগুয়েজ এর ডিরেক্টর ড.প্রতিভা রানী কর্মকার। অনুষ্ঠানে সভাপতিত্ব করেন সংগঠন এর উপদেষ্টা ও সিএসই ডিপার্টমেন্টের চেয়ারম্যান অধ্যাপক ড.উজ্জ্বল কুমার আচার্য্য। #CPP2019 #JnUITS

mediaAssets.title: Grand Finale of "Campus Power Presenter 2019" season 1.... অনুষ্ঠানে প্রধান অতিথি হিসেবে উপস্থিত ছিলেন জগন্নাথ বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের উপাচার্য অধ্যাপক ড. মীজানুর রহমান। বিশেষ অতিথি হিসেবে উপস্থিত ছিলেন বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের কোষাধ্যক্ষ অধ্যাপক ড. সেলিম ভুইয়া। এছাড়াও অনুষ্ঠানে বিচারক এর দায়িত্ব পালন করেন সিএসই ডিপার্টমেন্টের সহযোগী অধ্যাপক জনাব মেসবাউল আলম পলাশ, আইন অনুষদের ডিন খ্রিস্টিন রিচার্ডসন এবং ইন্সটিটিউট অব মডার্ণ ল্যাংগুয়েজ এর ডিরেক্টর ড.প্রতিভা রানী কর্মকার। অনুষ্ঠানে সভাপতিত্ব করেন সংগঠন এর উপদেষ্টা ও সিএসই ডিপার্টমেন্টের চেয়ারম্যান অধ্যাপক ড.উজ্জ্বল কুমার আচার্য্য। #CPP2019 #JnUITS

mediaAssets.altText: নির্বাচনী পোস্টার থেকে বানানো খাতা ! photo from Jagannath University IT Society activity

metadata.eventTitle: নির্বাচনী পোস্টার থেকে বানানো খাতা !

mediaAssets.title: নির্বাচনী পোস্টার থেকে বানানো খাতা !! কয়েক হাজার এতিম শিশু লেখার খাতা পাবে এই কয়দিনের মাঝে। বিভিন্ন ওয়ার্ডের কমিশনারগণ কল দিয়ে যাচ্ছেন তাঁদের সংগৃহীত পোস্টার নিয়ে আসার জন্য। জঞ্জাল থেকে শিক্ষার আলো ফুটানোর এই মিশনে অংশ নিচ্ছেন সকল দলের নেতৃবৃন্দ। পোস্টার পুড়িয়ে পরিবেশ বিপর্যয় না করে অনুগ্রহ করে তাদের সাথে যোগাযোগ করুন, উনারা নিজ দায়িত্বে সংগ্রহ করে নিয়ে আসবে। এছাড়া বিভিন্ন বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ে এসাইনমেন্ট পেপারে এক পৃষ্ঠা অব্যবহিত থাকে, যদি তাঁরা এসব উনাদের কাছে তুলে দিতে চায় তবে উনারা দরিদ্র শিক্ষার্থীদের মাঝে এগুলো পৌছে দিবে। Courtesy: বিদ্যানন্দ - Bidyanondo

mediaAssets.title: নির্বাচনী পোস্টার থেকে বানানো খাতা !! কয়েক হাজার এতিম শিশু লেখার খাতা পাবে এই কয়দিনের মাঝে। বিভিন্ন ওয়ার্ডের কমিশনারগণ কল দিয়ে যাচ্ছেন তাঁদের সংগৃহীত পোস্টার নিয়ে আসার জন্য। জঞ্জাল থেকে শিক্ষার আলো ফুটানোর এই মিশনে অংশ নিচ্ছেন সকল দলের নেতৃবৃন্দ। পোস্টার পুড়িয়ে পরিবেশ বিপর্যয় না করে অনুগ্রহ করে তাদের সাথে যোগাযোগ করুন, উনারা নিজ দায়িত্বে সংগ্রহ করে নিয়ে আসবে। এছাড়া বিভিন্ন বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ে এসাইনমেন্ট পেপারে এক পৃষ্ঠা অব্যবহিত থাকে, যদি তাঁরা এসব উনাদের কাছে তুলে দিতে চায় তবে উনারা দরিদ্র শিক্ষার্থীদের মাঝে এগুলো পৌছে দিবে। Courtesy: বিদ্যানন্দ - Bidyanondo

mediaAssets.altText: Today, we had a great start to our Jagannath University IT Society (JnUITS) online training program photo from Jagannath University IT Society activity

metadata.eventTitle: Today, we had a great start to our Jagannath University IT Society (JnUITS) online training program

mediaAssets.title: Today, we had a great start to our Jagannath University IT Society (JnUITS) online training program. We were delighted to welcome Md. Atikur Rahman was our first speaker, who shared his expertise on MS Office with us. He showed us how to use Word, Excel, and PowerPoint to create documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and more. He also gave us some tips and tricks to make our work easier and faster. He was engaging and informative, and we learned a lot from him. If you missed the session, don't worry. We have recorded it and will upload it to our JnUITS YouTube channel soon. You can watch it anytime and catch up on what you missed. Here is a screenshot of the session to give you a glimpse. We hope you enjoyed the session as much as we did. We want to thank Md. Atikur Rahman for his time and knowledge, and we look forward to seeing him again. Stay tuned for more updates on our upcoming speakers and topics. And don't forget to join us for the next session on September 8 at 8:00 PM.

mediaAssets.altText: 🕊️ In heartfelt remembrance of our late Vice-Chancellor, Professor Dr photo from Jagannath University IT Society activity

metadata.eventTitle: 🕊️ In heartfelt remembrance of our late Vice-Chancellor, Professor Dr

mediaAssets.title: 🕊️ In heartfelt remembrance of our late Vice-Chancellor, Professor Dr. Md. Imdadul Haque (Innalillahi wa Inna Ilahi Raziun), we share glimpses of our anniversary celebration that took place one week earlier. Today, on November 27, 2023, the Jagannath University IT Society (JnUITS) reflects on eight years of transformative innovation and academic excellence. 🎂 Originally planned for November 11, 2023, our celebration was rescheduled due to the untimely passing of our honorable VC Sir. Choosing a simpler approach, we commemorated the occasion with a modest gathering to express our deepest sympathy for the bereaved family. 🙏🏽 Our thoughts and prayers continue to be with Professor Dr. Md. Imdadul Haque's soul, and we ask Almighty Allah to grant him Jannah. 📸 Here are moments from our anniversary cake cutting and meeting held a week earlier. As a united Jagannath University IT Society, we honor the enduring spirit of technology, collaboration, and growth. In unity and remembrance. 🌟 #JnUITS #JnUITSAnniversary #InMemory #UnityInDiversity

metadata.eventTitle: Greetings from Jagannath University IT Society (JnUITS)

mediaAssets.title: Greetings from Jagannath University IT Society (JnUITS)! We are delighted to share some photos from past events where we had the honour of presenting a crest and certificate to the keynote speakers of the online workshop 'Digital Empowerment: Unleashing Productivity, Security & Career'. This workshop was an initiative of the Jagannath University IT Society (JnUITS). The workshop aimed to equip the participants with the essential skills and knowledge to thrive in the digital era. The workshop covered MS Office Essentials, Information Security, CV Writing, Presentation Skills, and Professional Development. We had a different speaker who shared their expertise and experience daily. They were: - Md. Atikur Rahman, Former Head of Documentation, JnUITS (Day 1: MS Office Essentials) - Md. Redwan Ahmed, Information Security Professional | President @ JnUITS (Day 2: Safeguarding Your Digital Realm) - Md Jamil Rowson, a distinguished HR Professional (Day 3: Outstanding CV Writing) - Shahnaowaz Kabbir Arpon, Founder of AanaaRi Creations and Area Director at Toastmasters International (Day 4: Presentations and Public Speaking) - Md Abdul Kaium, a renowned Career Coach, HR Professional and Trainer (Day 5: Employability and Professional Development) We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to them all for their time and generosity. They were very inspiring and motivating. We learned a lot from them and hope to apply their tips and advice personally and professionally. We are also happy to share that we received a crest from the AGREEN Foundation for participating in the "National Youth Entrepreneurship Summit - 2023", a great event for young entrepreneurs in Bangladesh. We learned much from the experts and influencers who spoke at the summit. We are thankful to the AGREEN Foundation for recognizing our efforts and achievements. We have transferred the crest to our JnUITS Mentor, Dr. Uzzal Kumar Acharjee, who has been a constant source of inspiration and guidance for us. #ProfessionalDevelopment #JnUITS #DigitalEmpowerment #gratitude #knowledgesharing #agreenfoundation #entrepreneurship

Honorable mentors Dr. Uzzal Kumar Acharjee & Dr. Md. Abu Layek, alongside founding president Hasan Mahmud, former president Shamim Ahmed, president Md. Redwan Ahmed, General Secretary Rashed Hossain Rony, and our dedicated JnUITS members shared moments of joy and gratitude at the “Sultan’s Dine” restaurant. Our guests appreciated the thoughtful arrangements. Ramadan Mubarak! 🌟🤲🌟 #JnUITS #Iftar2024 #RamadanBlessings"

mediaAssets.altText: 🌟 A Heartfelt Thank You to Our Speakers photo from Jagannath University IT Society activity

metadata.eventTitle: 🌟 A Heartfelt Thank You to Our Speakers

mediaAssets.title: 🌟 A Heartfelt Thank You to Our Speakers! 🌟 Jagannath University IT Society (JnUITS) successfully conducted a 3-day seminar from 25th to 28th February 2025 for our new members, focusing on essential professional skills. We extend our sincere gratitude to our distinguished speakers for their time, expertise, and valuable insights. 📅 Day 1: 25th February 2025 🎤 Session on Public Speaking in Presentation 👨‍🏫 Shahnaowaz Kabbir Arpon 📌 Assistant Manager- Marketing, Fair Food & Lifestyle Ltd. 📌 Founder: The DeshiCopter & AanaaRi Creations 📅 Day 2: 26th February 2025 📄 Session on CV/Resume Making (National & Global) 👨‍🏫 Md Shariful Islam 📌 Festival Programmer, Liberation Docfest Bangladesh 📅 Day 3: 28th February 2025 ✉️ Mastering Professional Email Writing 👨‍🏫 Abdullah Al Rahat 📌 Senior Territory Sales Manager, Reckitt Benckiser (BD) Plc Each session provided our participants with practical knowledge and industry insights, helping them build strong communication and professional skills. 🔹 Stay connected with JnUITS for more skill-enhancing events! #JnUITS #ThankYouSpeakers #SkillDevelopment #CareerGrowth #ProfessionalSkills #JagannathUniversity

metadata.eventTitle: Jagannath University IT Society successfully organized “Speak Up: Interactive Public Speaking Workshop” at the Departmen

mediaAssets.title: Jagannath University IT Society successfully organized “Speak Up: Interactive Public Speaking Workshop” at the Department of CSE, Level 5, Shaheed Sajid Academic Building on 23 September. The event was graced by Prof. Dr. Mohammed Nasir Uddin, Director of ICT Cell & Professor, Dept. of CSE, JnU, and Prof. Dr. Uzzal Kumar Acharjee, Mentor of Jagannath University IT Society. After their inspiring remarks, the keynote speaker Md. Solaiman Ahmed Zishan, Founder of Public Speaking Official and Public Speaking Olympiad, shared practical strategies for confident speaking. A fun Tongue Twister competition was held with 10 participants, where 2 winners received a special book authored by the speaker. Later, a Quiz segment took place, and the winners were awarded certificates from our Mentor. The workshop ended with certificates for all participants, creating an engaging and insightful experience to boost public speaking skills and confidence. #JnU #JnUITS #SpeakUp #PublicSpeaking #JagannathUniversity #StepAheadWithIT

After their inspiring remarks, the keynote speaker Md. Solaiman Ahmed Zishan, Founder of Public Speaking Official and Public Speaking Olympiad, shared practical strategies for confident speaking. A fun Tongue Twister competition was held with 10 participants, where 2 winners received a special book authored by the speaker. Later, a Quiz segment took place, and the winners were awarded certificates from our Mentor. The workshop ended with certificates for all participants, creating an engaging and insightful experience to boost public speaking skills and confidence. #JnU #JnUITS #SpeakUp #PublicSpeaking #JagannathUniversity #StepAheadWithIT

mediaAssets.title: Event Successfully Completed! Jagannath University IT Society (JnUITS) has successfully organized the webinar “Beyond the Classroom: Cultivating Skills for Tomorrow”! The session was held on 25 November 2025, at 9:00 PM via Google Meet, featuring an insightful talk by Arnob Saha, Additional General Secretary, Bangladesh Agricultural University Career Club. Throughout the session, he shared valuable perspectives on: 🔹 The importance of Extra-Curricular Activities 🔹 How Volunteering shapes your career 🔹 The role of Competitions and Research during undergraduate studies 🔹 Practical ways to grow beyond classroom learning 🔹 Building essential skills for future opportunities Participants gained real-life insights, practical guidance, and a deeper understanding of how to stand out in today’s competitive world. 🙏 A heartfelt thanks to Arnob Saha for delivering such an inspiring session, and sincere appreciation to all the participants for their active engagement. Your presence encourages us to keep organizing meaningful events. 🤝 The event was held in collaboration with IEEE JnU SB, JnURHSS, the freakonomists and IEEE CS BDC Team spark. 📌 Stay connected with JnUITS for more impactful sessions ahead! Together we learn, together we grow.

mediaAssets.altText: Jagannath University IT Society successfully organized a workshop today titled Odoo ERP : The Future of Business Automat photo from Jagannath University IT Society activity

metadata.eventTitle: Jagannath University IT Society successfully organized a workshop today titled Odoo ERP : The Future of Business Automat

mediaAssets.title: Jagannath University IT Society successfully organized a workshop today titled Odoo ERP : The Future of Business Automation. The session was honored by the presence of Professor Dr. Md. Abu Layek, Moderator of Jagannath University IT Society, who delivered a brief yet inspiring speech. The workshop featured Md. Rajibul Islam CEO of Dot BD Solutions Limited as a speaker, along with the company’s Chief Business Officer, who also shared valuable insights. Through active participant engagement, the speakers demonstrated key components of business operations in a hands-on manner and later explained how these processes can be efficiently managed using Odoo software. With enthusiastic and spontaneous participation from the attendees, the workshop turned into a successful, interactive, and enriching learning experience for everyone involved. Those who missed the workshop check the comments below

mediaAssets.title: 𝑨𝒏 𝑰𝒏𝒔𝒑𝒊𝒓𝒊𝒏𝒈 𝑬𝒙𝒄𝒉𝒂𝒏𝒈𝒆 𝒐𝒇 𝑽𝒊𝒔𝒊𝒐𝒏 𝒘𝒊𝒕𝒉 𝑶𝒖𝒓 𝑯𝒐𝒏𝒐𝒖𝒓𝒂𝒃𝒍𝒆 𝑽𝒊𝒄𝒆-𝑪𝒉𝒂𝒏𝒄𝒆𝒍𝒍𝒐𝒓 𝑺𝒊𝒓 Today, on March 31, 2026, JnUITS family had the distinct honour of meeting and exchanging greetings with our newly appointed Vice-Chancellor, Professor Dr. Md. Rais Uddin Sir, at the VC's Conference Room. During this fruitful discussion, the Honourable Vice-Chancellor emphasized the undeniable importance of Information Technology in the modern world. He encouraged our students to become more skilled and technically proficient, highlighting that collective effort is the key to advancing our university toward a brighter future. He specifically advised us to work with a solid and structured action plan for the university's development and graciously assured his full support for all our upcoming IT initiatives. Abu Layek, Moderator, JnUITS. We are deeply inspired by the guidance and are committed to working harder to build a "Smart Campus" through our strategic plans.

Rais Uddin Sir, at the VC's Conference Room. During this fruitful discussion, the Honourable Vice-Chancellor emphasized the undeniable importance of Information Technology in the modern world. He encouraged our students to become more skilled and technically proficient, highlighting that collective effort is the key to advancing our university toward a brighter future. He specifically advised us to work with a solid and structured action plan for the university's development and graciously assured his full support for all our upcoming IT initiatives. The meeting was also graced by the presence of: Professor Dr. Sabina Sharmin, Treasurer, Jagannath University. Professor Dr. Mohammad Nasir Uddin, Proctor & Advisor, JnUITS. Professor Dr. Md. Abu Layek, Moderator, JnUITS. We are deeply inspired by the guidance and are committed to working harder to build a "Smart Campus" through our strategic plans.

mediaAssets.title: A huge thank you to the 191 learners who joined us for the kick-off of our Basic Computer Course! Honestly, your enthusiasm was the best part of the day. Abu Layek Sir (Moderator, JnUITS) for his inspiring words. We also appreciate the guidance of our leadership team: Redwan Ahmed (Instructor & Former President) Imam Hasan (President, JnUITS) Bayazid Sarker (General Secretary, JnUITS) Tauhid Hasan (VP & Course Director) Shoutout to our host Piyush Saha and our hardworking Support Team for making the session so seamless! Let’s keep this learnign going. See you all in the next class! #JnUITS #BasicComputerCourse #LearningJourney #TechSkills #StepAhead #JagannathUniversity #BCCSeason8

We are thrilled to announce that our event, Speakathon v1.0, has been successfully completed! Starting from 19 participants in the online round, we narrowed it down to 6 outstanding speakers who competed in the onsite round, held grandly at the CSE Department VC Room. After an incredible battle of words, confidence, and brilliance, here are our winners: 🥇 Champion - Emamul Hossain Yash 🥈 1st Runner Up - Sohanur Rahman Sohan 🥉 2nd Runner Up - Shuvajit Biswas Heartiest congratulations to all three of you, you truly deserve it! A huge and special thank you to Dr. Tabassum Zaman Ma'am & Masum Billah Patowary Sir, for honoring our winners with prize money and certificates. Your presence made the moment even more special. We also extend our sincere gratitude to the entire judge panel for their time, effort, and valuable feedback throughout the event. This wouldn't have been possible without you. Now we want to hear from YOU! Would you like to see more events like this? Drop your thoughts in the comments below! Step Ahead With IT Team Jagannath University IT Society (JnUITS)

He walked us through how digital communication actually works in the real world, shared practical tips that we could take home and use the very next day, and stayed present through every question the audience threw at him. The QnA session was one of the highlights of the day. The curiosity in that room was something else. A heartfelt thank you to Prof. Dr. Tabassum Zaman Mam and Masum Billah Patowary Sir from the Department of Economics, who were with us from start to finish. Your presence and engagement meant a great addition and excitement to the entire team. To every student who asked a question, and everyone who listened with patience and gave so much back through their interaction, thank you. As a token of appreciation, we were honored to present Md. Abdul Quayyum Sir with a memento on behalf of JnUITS. Let us know was your favorite takeaway from today? Until next time, JnUITS.

mediaAssets.title: 𝘼 𝙍𝙤𝙤𝙢 𝙁𝙪𝙡𝙡 𝙤𝙛 𝘾𝙪𝙧𝙞𝙤𝙨𝙞𝙩𝙮 Today’s special seminar on 𝙈𝙖𝙨𝙩𝙚𝙧𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝙩𝙝𝙚 𝘼𝙧𝙩 𝙤𝙛 𝘿𝙞𝙜𝙞𝙩𝙖𝙡 𝘾𝙤𝙢𝙢𝙪𝙣𝙞𝙘𝙖𝙩𝙞𝙤𝙣𝙨 brought more people than we had seats for and seeing our own organizers sit on the floor just to make space for everyone made it a moment we’ll remember for a long time. We were deeply honored to welcome 𝙈𝙙. 𝘼𝙗𝙙𝙪𝙡 𝙌𝙪𝙖𝙮𝙮𝙪𝙢 𝙃𝙚𝙖𝙙 𝙤𝙛 𝘾𝙤𝙢𝙢𝙪𝙣𝙞𝙘𝙖𝙩𝙞𝙤𝙣𝙨, 𝙐𝙉𝘿𝙋 𝘽𝙖𝙣𝙜𝙡𝙖𝙙𝙚𝙨𝙝 to Jagannath University. He did not just speak at us. He walked us through how digital communication actually works in the real world, shared practical tips that we could take home and use the very next day, and stayed present through every question the audience threw at him. The QnA session was one of the highlights of the day. The curiosity in that room was something else. A heartfelt thank you to Prof. Dr. Tabassum Zaman Mam and Masum Billah Patowary Sir from the Department of Economics, who were with us from start to finish. Your presence and engagement meant a great addition and excitement to the entire team. To every student who asked a question, and everyone who listened with patience and gave so much back through their interaction, thank you. As a token of appreciation, we were honored to present Md. Abdul Quayyum Sir with a memento on behalf of JnUITS. Let us know was your favorite takeaway from today? Until next time, JnUITS.

albums.description: Jagannath University IT Society added 5 new photos. ক্যাম্পাস প্রায় বন্ধ অবস্থায়ও প্রথম দিন ক্যাম্পেইনে দাড়ুন অাগ্রহ দেখা গেছে 'টাইপিং মাস্টার কম্পিটিশন' নিয়ে। প্রচুর পরিমাণে ভলেন্টিয়ার লাগবে এত এত অংশগ্রহণকারীদের সামাল দিতে। দাড়ুন কিছু হবে বলে আশা করছি। যারা এখনও রেজিস্ট্রেশন করেননি তারা দ্রুত করে ফেলুন। নিজেকে প্রমান করার এখনই সুযোগ। আগামী রবিবার পর্যন্ত রেজিষ্টেশন চলবে শান্ত চত্তরে সকাল ১০ টা থকে ১ টা পর্যন্ত। শুধুমাত্র নবম থেকে তের তম আবর্তন পর্যন্ত। প্রথম পুরস্কার হিসেবে থাকছে একটি ল্যাপটপ।

albums.description: Jagannath University IT Society added 6 new photos. ৩য় দিনের মত চলছে 'জগন্নাথ বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় আইটি সোসাইটি সদস্য সংগ্রহ ২০১৯' এবং বহুল প্রতিক্ষিত 'বেসিক কম্পিউটার কোর্স ২০১৯' এর ফর্ম বিতরন। বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের ১৩তম ও ১৪তম ব্যাচের যেকোন ছাত্রছাত্রী সদস্য ফর্ম সংগ্রহ করতে পারবেন শান্ত চত্বর থেকে। সদস্য সংগ্রহ ফর্ম বিতরন চলবে আগামী বৃহঃস্পতি বার পর্যন্ত। এছাড়াও ১১তম থেকে ১৪তম ব্যাচের যেকেউ বেসিক কম্পিউটার কোর্স এর ফর্ম সংগ্রহ করতে পারবেন।

albums.description: Grand Finale of "Campus Power Presenter 2019" season 1.... অনুষ্ঠানে প্রধান অতিথি হিসেবে উপস্থিত ছিলেন জগন্নাথ বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের উপাচার্য অধ্যাপক ড. মীজানুর রহমান। বিশেষ অতিথি হিসেবে উপস্থিত ছিলেন বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের কোষাধ্যক্ষ অধ্যাপক ড. সেলিম ভুইয়া। এছাড়াও অনুষ্ঠানে বিচারক এর দায়িত্ব পালন করেন সিএসই ডিপার্টমেন্টের সহযোগী অধ্যাপক জনাব মেসবাউল আলম পলাশ, আইন অনুষদের ডিন খ্রিস্টিন রিচার্ডসন এবং ইন্সটিটিউট অব মডার্ণ ল্যাংগুয়েজ এর ডিরেক্টর ড.প্রতিভা রানী কর্মকার। অনুষ্ঠানে সভাপতিত্ব করেন সংগঠন এর উপদেষ্টা ও সিএসই ডিপার্টমেন্টের চেয়ারম্যান অধ্যাপক ড.উজ্জ্বল কুমার আচার্য্য। #CPP2019 #JnUITS

items.description: Grand Finale of "Campus Power Presenter 2019" season 1.... অনুষ্ঠানে প্রধান অতিথি হিসেবে উপস্থিত ছিলেন জগন্নাথ বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের উপাচার্য অধ্যাপক ড. মীজানুর রহমান। বিশেষ অতিথি হিসেবে উপস্থিত ছিলেন বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের কোষাধ্যক্ষ অধ্যাপক ড. সেলিম ভুইয়া। এছাড়াও অনুষ্ঠানে বিচারক এর দায়িত্ব পালন করেন সিএসই ডিপার্টমেন্টের সহযোগী অধ্যাপক জনাব মেসবাউল আলম পলাশ, আইন অনুষদের ডিন খ্রিস্টিন রিচার্ডসন এবং ইন্সটিটিউট অব মডার্ণ ল্যাংগুয়েজ এর ডিরেক্টর ড.প্রতিভা রানী কর্মকার। অনুষ্ঠানে সভাপতিত্ব করেন সংগঠন এর উপদেষ্টা ও সিএসই ডিপার্টমেন্টের চেয়ারম্যান অধ্যাপক ড.উজ্জ্বল কুমার আচার্য্য। #CPP2019 #JnUITS

albums.description: নির্বাচনী পোস্টার থেকে বানানো খাতা !! কয়েক হাজার এতিম শিশু লেখার খাতা পাবে এই কয়দিনের মাঝে। বিভিন্ন ওয়ার্ডের কমিশনারগণ কল দিয়ে যাচ্ছেন তাঁদের সংগৃহীত পোস্টার নিয়ে আসার জন্য। জঞ্জাল থেকে শিক্ষার আলো ফুটানোর এই মিশনে অংশ নিচ্ছেন সকল দলের নেতৃবৃন্দ। পোস্টার পুড়িয়ে পরিবেশ বিপর্যয় না করে অনুগ্রহ করে তাদের সাথে যোগাযোগ করুন, উনারা নিজ দায়িত্বে সংগ্রহ করে নিয়ে আসবে। এছাড়া বিভিন্ন বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ে এসাইনমেন্ট পেপারে এক পৃষ্ঠা অব্যবহিত থাকে, যদি তাঁরা এসব উনাদের কাছে তুলে দিতে চায় তবে উনারা দরিদ্র শিক্ষার্থীদের মাঝে এগুলো পৌছে দিবে। Courtesy: বিদ্যানন্দ - Bidyanondo

items.altText: The journey of JnUITS Presents ''IdeaQuakes 2020'' Powered by Lagvelki was full of impediments photo from Jagannath University IT Society activity
items.description: The journey of JnUITS Presents ''IdeaQuakes 2020'' Powered by Lagvelki was full of impediments. Every round challenged participants to wield their fullest potentials idea, critical analysis and creative abilities. With the Top 8 Teams reaching the final round, only the best ones survived the final battle. Ladies and Gentleman, we hereby present you The Winners of JnUITS Presents ''IdeaQuakes 2020'' Powered by Lagvelki . Champion : Code Red from Islamic University of Technology-IUT, OIC 1st Runner-up : Team Impact from East West University 2nd Runner-Up R Cube from Bangladesh University of Professionals - BUP We also congratulate all the teams who have participated and tried their best. Our good wishes to you and we believe you will come victorious one day as well.

albums.description: Jagannath University IT Society Presents Seminar on " Seminar of “BrainChild” on basic Apps Development". The Seminar was introduced to ensure that all the participants get polished with basic app development and its current market demand worldwide. Over 100+ students from Jagannath University have participated in the seminar. The Seminar was conducted by Mr Sahadat Hossain, Software Engineer at LasTrust Inc. (Japan) and also a student of the CSE Department of Jagannath University. Jagannath University IT Society is honoured and grateful to our instructor for shedding light on the basic Apps Development and to the audience for their huge response. #BrainChild #StepAheadwithIT

items.description: Greetings from Jagannath University IT Society (JnUITS)! We are delighted to share some photos from past events where we had the honour of presenting a crest and certificate to the keynote speakers of the online workshop 'Digital Empowerment: Unleashing Productivity, Security & Career'. This workshop was an initiative of the Jagannath University IT Society (JnUITS). The workshop aimed to equip the participants with the essential skills and knowledge to thrive in the digital era. The workshop covered MS Office Essentials, Information Security, CV Writing, Presentation Skills, and Professional Development. We had a different speaker who shared their expertise and experience daily. They were: - Md. Atikur Rahman, Former Head of Documentation, JnUITS (Day 1: MS Office Essentials) - Md. Redwan Ahmed, Information Security Professional | President @ JnUITS (Day 2: Safeguarding Your Digital Realm) - Md Jamil Rowson, a distinguished HR Professional (Day 3: Outstanding CV Writing) - Shahnaowaz Kabbir Arpon, Founder of AanaaRi Creations and Area Director at Toastmasters International (Day 4: Presentations and Public Speaking) - Md Abdul Kaium, a renowned Career Coach, HR Professional and Trainer (Day 5: Employability and Professional Development) We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to them all for their time and generosity. They were very inspiring and motivating. We learned a lot from them and hope to apply their tips and advice personally and professionally. We are also happy to share that we received a crest from the AGREEN Foundation for participating in the "National Youth Entrepreneurship Summit - 2023", a great event for young entrepreneurs in Bangladesh. We learned much from the experts and influencers who spoke at the summit. We are thankful to the AGREEN Foundation for recognizing our efforts and achievements. We have transferred the crest to our JnUITS Mentor, Dr. Uzzal Kumar Acharjee, who has been a constant source of inspiration and guidance for us. #ProfessionalDevelopment #JnUITS #DigitalEmpowerment #gratitude #knowledgesharing #agreenfoundation #entrepreneurship

albums.description: Alhamdulillah! 🌙🕌 Iftar & Dua Mahfil - 2024: A heartwarming gathering where the Jagannath University IT Society (JnUITS) family came together to break fast and seek blessings. Honorable mentors Dr. Uzzal Kumar Acharjee & Dr. Md. Abu Layek, alongside founding president Hasan Mahmud, former president Shamim Ahmed, president Md. Redwan Ahmed, General Secretary Rashed Hossain Rony, and our dedicated JnUITS members shared moments of joy and gratitude at the “Sultan’s Dine” restaurant. Our guests appreciated the thoughtful arrangements. Ramadan Mubarak! 🌟🤲🌟 #JnUITS #Iftar2024 #RamadanBlessings"

albums.description: 🌟 A Heartfelt Thank You to Our Speakers! 🌟 Jagannath University IT Society (JnUITS) successfully conducted a 3-day seminar from 25th to 28th February 2025 for our new members, focusing on essential professional skills. We extend our sincere gratitude to our distinguished speakers for their time, expertise, and valuable insights. 📅 Day 1: 25th February 2025 🎤 Session on Public Speaking in Presentation 👨‍🏫 Shahnaowaz Kabbir Arpon 📌 Assistant Manager- Marketing, Fair Food & Lifestyle Ltd. 📌 Founder: The DeshiCopter & AanaaRi Creations 📅 Day 2: 26th February 2025 📄 Session on CV/Resume Making (National & Global) 👨‍🏫 Md Shariful Islam 📌 Festival Programmer, Liberation Docfest Banglad

albums.description: Jagannath University IT Society successfully organized “Speak Up: Interactive Public Speaking Workshop” at the Department of CSE, Level 5, Shaheed Sajid Academic Building on 23 September. The event was graced by Prof. Dr. Mohammed Nasir Uddin, Director of ICT Cell & Professor, Dept. of CSE, JnU, and Prof. Dr. Uzzal Kumar Acharjee, Mentor of Jagannath University IT Society. After their inspiring remarks, the keynote speaker Md. Solaiman Ahmed Zishan, Founder of Public Speaking Official and Public Speaking Olympiad, shared practical strategies for confident speaking. A fun Tongue Twister competition was held with 10 participants, where 2 winners received a special book authored by the speaker.

items.description: Jagannath University IT Society successfully organized “Speak Up: Interactive Public Speaking Workshop” at the Department of CSE, Level 5, Shaheed Sajid Academic Building on 23 September. The event was graced by Prof. Dr. Mohammed Nasir Uddin, Director of ICT Cell & Professor, Dept. of CSE, JnU, and Prof. Dr. Uzzal Kumar Acharjee, Mentor of Jagannath University IT Society. After their inspiring remarks, the keynote speaker Md. Solaiman Ahmed Zishan, Founder of Public Speaking Official and Public Speaking Olympiad, shared practical strategies for confident speaking. A fun Tongue Twister competition was held with 10 participants, where 2 winners received a special book authored by the speaker. Later, a Quiz segment took place, and the winners were awarded certificates from our Mentor. The workshop ended with certificates for all participants, creating an engaging and insightful experience to boost public speaking skills and confidence. #JnU #JnUITS #SpeakUp #PublicSpeaking #JagannathUniversity #StepAheadWithIT

The session was honored by the presence of Professor Dr. Md. Abu Layek, Moderator of Jagannath University IT Society, who delivered a brief yet inspiring speech. The workshop featured Md. Rajibul Islam CEO of Dot BD Solutions Limited as a speaker, along with the company’s Chief Business Officer, who also shared valuable insights. Through active participant engagement, the speakers demonstrated key components of business operations in a hands-on manner and later explained how these processes can be efficiently managed using Odoo software. With enthusiastic and spontaneous participation from the attendees, the workshop turned into a successful, interactive, and enriching learning experience for everyone involved. Those who missed the workshop check the comments below

albums.description: New Member Recruitment 2026 | Viva Completed Today, Jagannath University IT Society (JnUITS) successfully completed the final stage of its new member recruitment process—Viva Voce. The confidence, preparation, and enthusiasm shown by all participants were truly commendable. Your passion and dedication continue to inspire JnUITS to move forward. 📌 Important: Candidates who missed the MCQ or Viva session are requested to contact us via the official email by tonight. 📧 Email: itsociety@association.jnu.ac.bd 📢 Result Update: The recruitment results will be published very soon. Best wishes to everyone! 💙 Step Ahead With IT. #JnUITS #StepAheadWithIT #JagannathUniversity

Best wishes to everyone! 💙 Step Ahead With IT. #JnUITS #StepAheadWithIT #JagannathUniversity

items.description: We are really happy to share that our session “𝗠𝗮𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝗖𝗩 𝗪𝗿𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗟𝗶𝗻𝗸𝗲𝗱𝗜𝗻 𝗢𝗽𝘁𝗶𝗺𝗶𝘇𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝘁𝗼 𝗟𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗗𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗺 𝗝𝗼𝗯” has been completed successfully with a great response from everyone. items.description: 𝑩𝑪𝑪 𝑺𝒆𝒂𝒔𝒐𝒏 8.0 𝑹𝒆𝒈𝒊𝒔𝒕𝒓𝒂𝒕𝒊𝒐𝒏 𝑩𝒐𝒐𝒕𝒉 𝑼𝒑𝒅𝒂𝒕𝒆 The first day at our BCC Season 8.0 registration booth received an amazing response from students One question we heard the most “Is it really possible to learn all these modules in a single course at such a low course fee?” Yes, it is possible. Because Jagannath University IT Society (JnUITS) works with one mission to promote IT and internet literacy among all students of the university. Our goal is impact, accessibility, and practical skill development. We will continue the registration booth for two more days. albums.description: JnUITS Iftar Mahfil & Award Giving Night Part 1 Alhamdulillah, our program was successfully held at Unique Restaurant, Katherpul Moor. The evening became more special with the presence of our respected senior alumni of JnUITS including Emon bhai, Shamim bhai, Asif Ahmed Rojel bhai, Parvez Hossain bhai, and Sabid Ibn Rabbani bhai. From the industry, we were honored to have Rajib M. Moon from Bangladesh ICT & Innovation Network (BIIN) with us. We were privileged to have our immediate past moderator Prof. Dr. Uzzal Kumar Acharjee and our current moderator Prof. Dr. Md. Abu Layek sir present at the program. Around 60 Members, Junior Coordinators, and Executive Committee members joined the Iftar

items.altText: 𝑱𝒏𝑼𝑰𝑻𝑺 𝑰𝒇𝒕𝒂𝒓 𝑴𝒂𝒉𝒇𝒊𝒍 & 𝑨𝒘𝒂𝒓𝒅 𝑮𝒊𝒗𝒊𝒏𝒈 𝑵𝒊𝒈𝒉𝒕 𝑷𝒂𝒓𝒕 1 Alhamdulillah, our program was succ photo from Jagannath University IT Society activity
items.description: 𝑱𝒏𝑼𝑰𝑻𝑺 𝑰𝒇𝒕𝒂𝒓 𝑴𝒂𝒉𝒇𝒊𝒍 & 𝑨𝒘𝒂𝒓𝒅 𝑮𝒊𝒗𝒊𝒏𝒈 𝑵𝒊𝒈𝒉𝒕 𝑷𝒂𝒓𝒕 1 Alhamdulillah, our program was successfully held at Unique Restaurant, Katherpul Moor. The evening became more special with the presence of our respected senior alumni of JnUITS including Emon bhai, Shamim bhai, Asif Ahmed Rojel bhai, Parvez Hossain bhai, and Sabid Ibn Rabbani bhai. From the industry, we were honored to have Rajib M. Moon from Bangladesh ICT & Innovation Network (BIIN) with us. We were privileged to have our immediate past moderator Prof. Dr. Uzzal Kumar Acharjee and our current moderator Prof. Dr. Md. Abu Layek sir present at the program. Around 60 Members, Junior Coordinators, and Executive Committee members joined the Iftar Mahfil and made the evening memorable. The program was hosted by Bayazid Sarkar, General Secretary of JnUITS, and the concluding speech was delivered by Imam Hasan, President of JnUITS. Our previous committee President, Md. Redwan Ahmed bhai, Rashed Hossain Rony bhai, and other respected seniors also conveyed their best wishes for the successful arrangement of the event, though they were not present at the program. The program started with inspiring speeches from our respected senior alumni. Afterwards, our representative from Jagannath University Central Student Union, Abdul Alim Arif, General Secretary of JnUCSU, delivered a short speech mentioning importance of IT in this digital era. Both of our respected moderator sirs also shared their valuable suggestions and guidance. Before Iftar, Abdul Alim Arif bhai led the dua. Part 2 of the Iftar Mahfil and Award Giving Night is coming soon with some big updates. Also Stay tuned and catch us tomorrow at Shanto Chattor at the Basic Computer Course (BCC) Booth. Team JnUITS

items.description: 𝑱𝒏𝑼𝑰𝑻𝑺 𝑰𝒇𝒕𝒂𝒓 𝑴𝒂𝒉𝒇𝒊𝒍 & 𝑨𝒘𝒂𝒓𝒅 𝑵𝒊𝒈𝒉𝒕 𝑷𝒂𝒓𝒕 2 Part 2 of our memorable evening was dedicated to recognizing dedication, leadership, and hard work. The Best Junior Coordinator Award, Best Sub-Executive Award, and Best Executive Award were officially handed over to the awardees by our respected alumni, honorable teachers, representative of Jagannath University Central Student Union, and industry leaders. These recognitions were not just awards, but a source of inspiration for our new members to work with passion and commitment for Jagannath University IT Society. We are also grateful to Bangladesh ICT & Innovation Network (BIIN) for providing special gift items for our society, which were formally handed over to our respected moderator sir during the program. Congratulations to all the award recipients! Your dedication truly reflects the spirit of JnUITS. We warmly welcome you to continue contributing with even greater enthusiasm in the future. At this inspiring moment, we would also like to remind everyone that BCC online registration is currently ongoing. Don’t forget to enroll in the course at join.jnuits.org.bd/bcc Team JnUITS

These recognitions were not just awards, but a source of inspiration for our new members to work with passion and commitment for Jagannath University IT Society. We are also grateful to Bangladesh ICT & Innovation Network (BIIN) for providing special gift items for our society, which were formally handed over to our respected moderator sir during the program. Congratulations to all the award recipients! Your dedication truly reflects the spirit of JnUITS. We warmly welcome you to continue contributing with even greater enthusiasm in the future. At this inspiring moment, we would also like to remind everyone that BCC online registration is currently ongoing. Don’t forget to enroll in the course at join.jnuits.org.bd/bcc Team JnUITS

items.altText: 𝘼 𝙍𝙤𝙤𝙢 𝙁𝙪𝙡𝙡 𝙤𝙛 𝘾𝙪𝙧𝙞𝙤𝙨𝙞𝙩𝙮 Today’s special seminar on 𝙈𝙖𝙨𝙩𝙚𝙧𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝙩𝙝𝙚 𝘼𝙧𝙩 𝙤𝙛 𝘿𝙞𝙜𝙞𝙩 photo from Jagannath University IT Society activity
items.description: 𝘼 𝙍𝙤𝙤𝙢 𝙁𝙪𝙡𝙡 𝙤𝙛 𝘾𝙪𝙧𝙞𝙤𝙨𝙞𝙩𝙮 Today’s special seminar on 𝙈𝙖𝙨𝙩𝙚𝙧𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝙩𝙝𝙚 𝘼𝙧𝙩 𝙤𝙛 𝘿𝙞𝙜𝙞𝙩𝙖𝙡 𝘾𝙤𝙢𝙢𝙪𝙣𝙞𝙘𝙖𝙩𝙞𝙤𝙣𝙨 brought more people than we had seats for and seeing our own organizers sit on the floor just to make space for everyone made it a moment we’ll remember for a long time. We were deeply honored to welcome 𝙈𝙙. 𝘼𝙗𝙙𝙪𝙡 𝙌𝙪𝙖𝙮𝙮𝙪𝙢 𝙃𝙚𝙖𝙙 𝙤𝙛 𝘾𝙤𝙢𝙢𝙪𝙣𝙞𝙘𝙖𝙩𝙞𝙤𝙣𝙨, 𝙐𝙉𝘿𝙋 𝘽𝙖𝙣𝙜𝙡𝙖𝙙𝙚𝙨𝙝 to Jagannath University. He did not just speak at us. He walked us through how digital communication actually works in the real world, shared practical tips that we could take home and use the very next day, and stayed present through every question the audience threw at him. The QnA session was one of the highlights of the day. The curiosity in that room was something else. A heartfelt thank you to Prof. Dr. Tabassum Zaman Mam and Masum Billah Patowary Sir from the Department of Economics, who were with us from start to finish. Your presence and engagement meant a great addition and excitement to the entire team. To every student who asked a question, and everyone who listened with patience and gave so much back through their interaction, thank you. As a token of appreciation, we were honored to present Md. Abdul Quayyum Sir with a memento on behalf of JnUITS. Let us know was your favorite takeaway from today? Until next time, JnUITS.

He walked us through how digital communication actually works in the real world, shared practical tips that we could take home and use the very next day, and stayed present through every question the audience threw at him. The QnA session was one of the highlights of the day. The curiosity in that room was something else. A heartfelt thank you to Prof. Dr. Tabassum Zaman Mam and Masum Billah Patowary Sir from the Department of Economics, who were with us from start to finish. Your presence and engagement meant a great addition and excitement to the entire team. To every student who asked a question, and everyone who listened with patience and gave so much back through their interaction, thank you. As a token of appreciation, we were honored to present Md. Abdul Quayyum Sir with a memento on behalf of JnUITS. Let us know was your favorite takeaway from today? Until next time, JnUITS.

albums.description: Congratulations to all the winners, participants & grand finalists of Speakathon v1.0 by JnUITS! We are thrilled to announce that our event, Speakathon v1.0, has been successfully completed! Starting from 19 participants in the online round, we narrowed it down to 6 outstanding speakers who competed in the onsite round, held grandly at the CSE Department VC Room.
